basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer living in Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in technology and spend a lot of my free time tinkering with computers and gaming. I recently got into the MCU and love discussing fan theories. I work from home, so I'm online at various times throughout the day, usually between 10 AM and 8 PM CST. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring local coffee shops and tech stores.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin. My job as a software engineer has given me practical knowledge in programming and problem-solving. I've self-taught myself a lot about computer hardware and enjoy building custom PCs.
